min_col, min_row, max_col, max_row = range_boundaries(answer_range)

    ref = ws1.cell(row=row, column=s1_ref_col).value
    total = totals_by_reference.get(ref, 0)
    if all_integral and isinstance(total, float) and total.is_integer():
        total = int(total)
